page_note: Page contains two clearly distinct structural units. Unit 1 (segs 0-20) is sustained cosmological-correspondential substrate teaching about the Fathers in the upper place being mirrored downward — icons, shadows, mysteries cast onto the earth and waters. The teaching maps cosmos→cosmos: upper Fathers → their reflections, the begotten child → his shadow, body from earth → shadow stretched upward. The seam flag at seg 9 (ⲉⲧⲃⲉ ⲡⲉⲓ + ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ) does not actually mark an editorial seam here — 'mystery' here is cosmic-correspondential (the mystery of the Fathers manifest in waters), not institutional. Unit 2 (segs 21-33) is the opening of Kephalaion 102 'Concerning the Mind of Light' — chapter heading, apostolic dialogue frame, and an elect's question about the Mind of Light dwelling in the holy church and bearing-upon the faithful elect. This second unit is dominated by ecclesial+dialogue framing (the editorial fatigue score of +11.38 captures this perfectly: the second half drifts hard into apostolic_dialogue +31.7 and manichaean_ecclesial +18.3). The substrate cosmological topic (Mind of Light) is being framed inside an ecclesial comparison: Mind of Light : holy church :: apostle : disciples.
